nodes.nie.text.t: "No? Then I'll walk it myself, once my arse lets up."

nodes.s.text.t: A fat man sits by the road with a handcart full of candles, fanning himself with his hat. "Tobiasz, chandler. Sister Halina at the Crossroads Shrine ordered a bundle of candles, and I'm not going a step further, this heat's got me pinned. Will you take them? Tell her it's first-rate wax, and don't let her fool you when she starts grumbling about the price."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Tobiasz lays the bundle in your arms as if it were a clutch of eggs. "Just don't light them on the way. I've few enough customers as it is."
